data.long_meaning: Shyamal is a name of Lord Krishna, meaning 'God of Gods'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shyama', which means 'dark' or 'black'. The name Shyamal carries the meaning “God of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shyamal usually hope their child will grow to embody god of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
